objectives.en: Describe the events of one cardiac cycle
Calculate stroke volume, heart rate and cardiac output
Read the P wave, QRS complex and T wave of an ECG

narration.en: Put a stethoscope on a friend's chest and you hear two sounds, lub and dub, again and again. Each pair is one cardiac cycle. What causes each sound?
narration.kn: ಸ್ನೇಹಿತನ ಎದೆಗೆ ಸ್ಟೆತೊಸ್ಕೋಪ್ ಇಟ್ಟರೆ ಲಬ್ ಮತ್ತು ಡಬ್ ಎಂಬ ಎರಡು ಶಬ್ದಗಳು ಕೇಳುತ್ತವೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಜೊತೆಯೂ ಒಂದು ಹೃದಯ ಚಕ್ರ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಶಬ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವೇನು?

body.en: The sequence of events in the heart that repeats with every beat is the cardiac cycle: systole (contraction) and diastole (relaxation) of both atria and both ventricles. The SAN fires and the atria contract (atrial systole), pushing about 30 per cent more blood into the ventricles. The impulse reaches the ventricles through the AVN and AV bundle, and ventricular systole closes the tricuspid and bicuspid valves and opens the semilunar valves. When the ventricles relax, the semilunar valves close. The heart beats about 72 times a minute, so one cycle lasts about 0.8 s. Each ventricle pumps about 70 mL per beat, the stroke volume.
body.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಬಡಿತದಲ್ಲಿ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆಯಾಗುವ ಘಟನೆಗಳ ಸರಣಿಯೇ ಹೃದಯ ಚಕ್ರ. ನಿಮಿಷಕ್ಕೆ 72 ಬಡಿತಗಳಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಒಂದು ಚಕ್ರ ಸುಮಾರು 0.8 ಸೆಕೆಂಡ್. ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೃತ್ಕುಕ್ಷಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಬಡಿತಕ್ಕೆ ಸುಮಾರು 70 ಮಿ.ಲೀ ರಕ್ತ ಪಂಪ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಹೃದಯ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆ ಸುಮಾರು 5 ಲೀಟರ್.

points.en: Lub: closure of the tricuspid and bicuspid valves
Dub: closure of the semilunar valves
Cardiac output = stroke volume × heart rate ≈ 5 L/min

narration.en: The teacher draws the timing of one cardiac cycle, sketches an ECG and calculates the cardiac output.

say.en: At 72 beats a minute one cardiac cycle takes about 0.8 seconds. Here is how that time is shared.
In ventricular systole the AV valves shut and the semilunar valves open; when the ventricles relax, the semilunar valves shut.

text.en: V systole: AV shut, SL open

say.en: The ECG records the heart’s electrical activity. Watch for the P wave, the QRS complex and the T wave.
P is atrial depolarisation, QRS is ventricular depolarisation, and T is ventricular repolarisation. Count the QRS complexes to get the heart rate.
Now the numbers: cardiac output equals heart rate times stroke volume.

title.en: The cardiac cycle and the ECG

caption.en: At 72 beats a minute one cardiac cycle lasts about 0.8 s: the atria contract (about 0.1 s), then the ventricles (about 0.3 s), then all chambers relax (about 0.4 s). The P wave marks atrial excitation, QRS ventricular excitation, and T the return of the ventricles to normal. Cardiac output is stroke volume times heart rate.
caption.kn: 72 ಬಡಿತ/ನಿಮಿಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಹೃದಯ ಚಕ್ರ ಸುಮಾರು 0.8 ಸೆ: ಹೃತ್ಕರ್ಣ ಸಂಕೋಚನ (0.1 ಸೆ), ಹೃತ್ಕುಕ್ಷಿ ಸಂಕೋಚನ (0.3 ಸೆ), ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ (0.4 ಸೆ). P, QRS, T ತರಂಗಗಳು. ಹೃದಯ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆ = ಪಾರ್ಶ್ವ ಪರಿಮಾಣ × ಹೃದಯ ಬಡಿತ.

body.en: An ECG is a graphical record of the electrical activity of the heart during a cardiac cycle. The P wave shows the depolarisation (excitation) of the atria, which leads to atrial contraction. The QRS complex shows the depolarisation of the ventricles, which starts ventricular contraction. The T wave shows the return of the ventricles from the excited to the normal state, repolarisation; its end marks the end of systole. Counting the QRS complexes in a given time gives the heart rate, and any deviation in shape points to a possible abnormality.
body.kn: ಇಸಿಜಿ ಹೃದಯದ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆಯ ನಕ್ಷೆ. P ತರಂಗ ಹೃತ್ಕರ್ಣಗಳ ವಿಧ್ರುವೀಕರಣ, QRS ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣ ಹೃತ್ಕುಕ್ಷಿಗಳ ವಿಧ್ರುವೀಕರಣ, T ತರಂಗ ಹೃತ್ಕುಕ್ಷಿಗಳ ಪುನರ್ಧ್ರುವೀಕರಣ. QRS ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣಗಳನ್ನು ಎಣಿಸಿ ಹೃದಯ ಬಡಿತ ದರವನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಬಹುದು.

problem.en: An ECG strip shows 18 QRS complexes in 15 seconds. The person's stroke volume is 70 mL. Find the heart rate, the duration of one cardiac cycle and the cardiac output.

steps.en: Duration of one cycle = 60 ÷ 72 ≈ 0.83 s (about 0.8 s).
Cardiac output = 70 mL × 72 = 5040 mL per minute ≈ 5 L/min.

answer.en: 72 beats/min, about 0.8 s per cycle, about 5 L/min

body.en: P comes first because the Atria are first. QRS is the big spike because the big Ventricles fire. T is the Tidy-up: ventricles recover (repolarise).
